title: Nourishing Juicy French Chickpea Flatbread
description: A salty and juicy French dish featuring chickpea flour, double-rise-bread, served in a scallop shell, low-sodium-friendly.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine chickpea flour, warm water, yeast, and salt, mix until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Punch down the dough and divide it into 4 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle, about 1/8 inch thick.
Brush the dough with olive oil and sprinkle with garlic and rosemary.
Place each flatbread in a scallop shell and bake for 15 minutes, or until golden brown.
